ideaData.title: Fold BDU, BMS master and charge control into one 'Energy Master' unit
ideaData.sourcePointer: BMW_iX3_Gen6_Battery_Benchmark.xlsx › '5 VAVE from this study' row 3
ideaData.technicalDescription: How it works · benchmark (as stated): One housing, one HV connector set and one harness replaces three boxes; the unit sits on top of the pack and is serviced through the rear seat without dropping the pack. Benchmark: BMW Gen6 Energy Master (illustrative). Spec: deletes 2 housings + ~1.5 m HV/LV harness; contactor and pyro ratings HELD
ideaData.costReductionMechanism: Cost effect on the 105 kWh GROSS reference pack (study): −€40 to −€70 / −€0.4 to −€0.7 per kWh GROSS
ideaData.riskNotes: Certification: NONE if contactor/pyro ratings and welding detection are held; RE-TEST if ratings change (LV 123). Trade-off: single point of failure, thermal density. Proven (BMW LIVE). Effort: medium. Evidence: tab 1 rows 24–25.
ideaData.studyCombinedCapture: COMBINED CAPTURE (non-additive): E1 + C2 land on the same overhead block — realistic combined −€60 to −€90 / −€0.6 to −€0.9 per kWh GROSS at pack level, NOT the sum. E2 and S2 are cost TRANSFERS that raise pack cost and lower vehicle cost; never book them as pack savings.

ideaData.title: Split the pack into two 400 V halves for charging instead of fitting a DC booster
ideaData.sourcePointer: BMW_iX3_Gen6_Battery_Benchmark.xlsx › '5 VAVE from this study' row 4
ideaData.technicalDescription: How it works · benchmark (as stated): Two contactor groups reconfigure the pack series/parallel on a 400 V charger; deletes the 400→800 V booster carried elsewhere in the vehicle. Benchmark: BMW Gen6 (illustrative). Spec: +1 contactor set (~€60–90*) in the pack; −1 booster (~€250–400*) at vehicle level
ideaData.costReductionMechanism: Cost effect on the 105 kWh GROSS reference pack (study): +€75 / +€0.7 per kWh GROSS in the pack; −€250 to −€400 at VEHICLE level
ideaData.riskNotes: Certification: RE-TEST — switching contactors are PROTECTED ratings (LV 123, ISO 6469-1). Trade-off: pack-level cost RISES; judge at vehicle level only. Proven. Evidence: tab 2 'Configuration'.

ideaData.riskNotes: Certification: RE-HOMOLOGATION — crash and bottom-impact case moves into the pack (GB 38031 150 J; R100). Trade-off: pack repair = body repair; sealing interfaces. Proven at 3 OEMs. Evidence: tab 1 row 19.

ideaData.title: Move the propagation case onto per-cell venting (46xx format)
ideaData.sourcePointer: BMW_iX3_Gen6_Battery_Benchmark.xlsx › '5 VAVE from this study' row 6
ideaData.technicalDescription: How it works · benchmark (as stated): Each cylindrical cell vents through its own burst feature into a common bottom channel, so barrier material between cells shrinks. Benchmark: BMW Gen6 bottom venting, Tesla 4680 (illustrative). Spec: barrier content −€25 to −€40* per pack; requires GB 38031 120-min result on the format
ideaData.costReductionMechanism: Cost effect on the 105 kWh GROSS reference pack (study): −€30 / −€0.3 per kWh GROSS
ideaData.riskNotes: Certification: RE-HOMOLOGATION — PROTECTED line, GB 38031-2025 propagation test mandatory. Trade-off: only valid with a cylindrical cell decision (C-lever). Emerging for EU; Proven at Tesla. Evidence: tab 1 row 28.
ideaData.studyCombinedCapture: COMBINED CAPTURE (non-additive): E1 + C2 land on the same overhead block — realistic combined −€60 to −€90 / −€0.6 to −€0.9 per kWh GROSS at pack level, NOT the sum. E2 and S2 are cost TRANSFERS that raise pack cost and lower vehicle cost; never book them as pack savings.
